skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of single and multivariable calculus, including limits, derivatives, integrals, and their applications in economics and business.
Solve problems using calculus techniques and apply them to real-world economic and business scenarios.
Analyze and interpret mathematical models and economic theories using calculus.
Develop the ability to learn independently, work in groups, and take responsibility for personal and group tasks.
Apply calculus to economic concepts such as supply and demand, cost, revenue, profit, production functions, marginal analysis, and elasticity.
Use calculus to analyze business problems, optimize resource allocation, and maximize profit.
